The class keeps its values in self.items, so foldl can walk that list directly. Next I'll write the fold as a method. functools.reduce would hide the read/write order, so the loop stays explicit:
```python
def foldl(self, function, initial):
    acc = initial
    for item in self.items:
        acc = function(acc, item)
    return acc
```
That keeps the order of self.items intact.
